D7Digital

MIDI to CV

Keyboards and computers play the rack

Converts MIDI notes into pitch and gate for two voices, plus clock and start/stop from MIDI clock.

  • MIDI input on a 3.5 mm jack, type A and B
  • Channel set by learn function
  • Two voices, or one voice with velocity

Height3 U · 128.5 mm
Jacks7
